blind.description: A low, cylindrical stylized rock stepping stone or low platform. It has a flat top surface with chiseled, chipped bevels around its circumference, and faceted, segmented rocky sides. The surface is textured in warm earthy brown stone with lighter highlights on the cracks and beveled edges. The model is completely solid and continuous, resting flat on the ground with no hovering parts or base plinth.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular brown stone disc with notched, cracked rim edges and a flat central surface.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 feet tall (roughly one-quarter the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 3 feet in diameter (about half the figure's height).
